statement: Withdraw every comparative benchmark claim whose evidence is invalid (timeouts counted as success, /health substitutes, unverified envelopes, non-canonical workloads, constant phases/bytes, fabricated quantiles, label-hash identities, wrong dispatch family), retaining the original records as forensic history behind an append-only invalidation ledger; repair the comparative benchmark system into one canonical chain (typed operation outcomes with retained responses, canonical Scenario A workload through the existing adapters and shared open-loop/retry/sweep/semantic owners, fail-closed readiness and dataset verification, running-container identity, claim-specific admission, renderers that consume admitted claims only, offline recomputation) with the registered lab machines as the default execution target; prove with adversarial acceptance tests that the chain cannot publish a successful result when the product did not run, the wrong workload ran, the answer was wrong, the request timed out, the topology differed or the evidence is missing; and demonstrate one semantically verified real-product smoke run for Lagrange, TiDB and PostgreSQL on lab hosts, published as smoke.

constraints.statement: No new campaign is published before every currently published cell is classified valid-observed, product-failure, invalid-measurement, blocked, unsupported or not-measured; invalidation is an append-only ledger entry plus retained original records, never a rewrite of old records or a relabel with a newer version.

One execution/accounting/admission/publication chain; native adapters per product share the canonical workload, success semantics, retry owner, statistics and evidence owners. The bench_* smoke workload generator, the 33 ad-hoc proofs, the TCP-forwarder app service, constant phases/bytes, OPERATING_BOUNDARY_MAP prose, fixed recovery timings, label-hash digests and the mismatched sentinel are deleted, not kept behind a flag.

Scenario A keeps scenario-a-semantic-v1 (no benchmark-injected per-request deadline), scenario-a-retry-v1 and scenario-a-open-loop-v1; a campaign watchdog stops safely and leaves unresolved/unissued requests visible; a changed deadline policy needs a new profile identity and a fresh campaign.

The runner defaults to the registered lab inventory with machine locks and the thermal gate; GCP is explicit and creates no new billable infrastructure; no host security is weakened (no docker.sock chmod, host-key verification kept, no 0.0.0.0/0 trust).

Scenario B for Lagrange is blocked until the compiled service journey exists; Scenario C, scale-out, partition, movement, RTT and recovery claims are not-measured or unsupported until actually executed and observed; a smoke run is published as smoke, never as sustained capacity or a p99 claim.

Independent reviewer with fresh context inspects deployment, requests, responses, correctness checks, accounting and renderers, executes falsification tests and recomputes selected numbers; approval recorded with --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve before landing; the epic is not marked complete.
